Once an hour, move every service whose i: Once an hour, move every service whose image has a version tag (1.27.1, v2.3, 8.0.1-jdk17) to the newest tag of the same form in its registry. Patch stays within the current minor version (1.27.1 → 1.27.4), minor within the current major version (1.27.1 → 1.29.0), major takes any newer version (1.27.1 → 2.0.1). Tags like latest are never touched. A service can override this on its page or with the swarmdash.autoupdate label (off, patch, minor, major) under deploy.labels in compose. Each update is recorded in the audit log and sent to webhooks as service_image_updated.

Swarm configs are immutable, so saving c: Swarm configs are immutable, so saving creates a new config with this content and switches every service above to it, keeping the path it's mounted at - their tasks restart with the new content.
Swarm only weighs current node load when: Swarm only weighs current node load when placing new tasks - it never moves an already-running task onto a node that joined later. After adding or removing nodes, force-restart every replicated service so the scheduler re-places all their tasks across the nodes currently in the cluster (%v). Each service still rolls per its own update policy (parallelism/delay/order), so this doesn't take everything down at once. Global-mode services aren't included - they already run one task per eligible node automatically.
Swarm secrets are immutable, so rotating: Swarm secrets are immutable, so rotating creates a new secret with the new value and switches every service above to it, keeping the path it's mounted at - their tasks restart with the new value. The current value can't be shown: Docker never returns a secret's value.
